return_ordering.interpretation: Raw environment discounted returns, before replay loss and PPO/critic estimation. Stratified by environment slot and episode start update block; policies, reset randomness and sampled actions still differ. Minus5 only substitutes the terminal failure charge on the identical observed trajectory: G_new=G_old-3*gamma^(T-1). It is arithmetic sensitivity, not a trained policy, causal failure preference, or a change to any acceptance criterion.

temporal_weights.interpretation: Direct reward coefficient with value predictions fixed. Within a rollout it is (gamma*lambda)^lag until done; across rollout boundaries it is zero. Bootstrapped critic values can carry longer-term information. This is not a measured effective learning horizon or proof that the critic failed.

scope: All TRAIN controls of both changing-policy runs; all failures and right-censored episodes retained. Phase means weight controls, not independent sources. Last64-update summaries still mix changing policies. Actual logged heading/velocity/online-anchor rewards are reconstructed, terminal reward reconstructed from source and event flags; other rewards remain unallocated. Foot-aware lateral cost is NOT reconstructed. Its positive body-only penalty is a lower bound. First-minibatch replay gradients mix phases; no per-phase gradient or Adam-causality claim. No learning or new evaluation.
